messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error-rate observed for org AuraSurge (org_id=aura-1234). 5xxs up ~18% over baseline, request drop due to RL. Paging oncall Talia Nguyen. Links: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alert/1748501234 :rotating_light:
Talia Nguyen: I'm on it. grabbing dashboard now. which org quota is hitting?
Samir Patel: AuraSurge is tripping per-org rate limit and the edge qps is spiking. Their qps went from 120 -> 1800 in 6m. Errors are mostly 429/503 from the edge.
Talia Nguyen: Can we soften limits temporarily? want to avoid customer-facing 503s.
Marc D'Souza: Recommend emergency RL adjustment: increase org rl from 200 qps -> 1200 qps for 20m while we throttle clients more gracefully.
Kelly Ortiz: +1. Need audit trail and a revert plan. Also notify account team (cc @acct-ops) that we're changing limits.
Talia Nguyen: Preparing the hotfix. Executing admin change now. Command: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  "https://admin.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/aura-1234/rate_limit/adjust" \ 
  -d '{"qps":1200, "duration_minutes":20, "reason":"emergency burst - auto-mitigate 5xx spike"}'```
ops-bot: action:rate_limit_adjust STARTED by Talia Nguyen for aura-1234 -> target_qps=1200 duration=20m id=rl-5467
deploy-bot: audit:rl_change noted in deploy-log id=rl-5467 user=Talia Nguyen
Talia Nguyen: Applied. ops-bot reports success: `status:ok`
Samir Patel: Metrics look better immediately. 5xx drop from 18% -> 2.5% within 90s. Latency briefly increased on a few hosts, but within SLO.
Kelly Ortiz: How many customers affected? any collateral damage?
Samir Patel: AuraSurge accounted for ~64% of the spike; about 9 other orgs saw small QPS bumps but no degradations. We routed a small portion to fallback model (approx 0.8% global).
Marc D'Souza: I've left a granular note in the rl audit: `manual emergency bump due to traffic anomaly; follow-up: throttling rules + prefix cache tuning`
Talia Nguyen: Notifying account team + support. @Kelly please confirm communications. Also starting a short incident writeup in #postmortems later.
Kelly Ortiz: Will ping account ops and send a brief note to AuraSurge: "We've applied a temporary rate increase to keep your service healthy; our engineers are investigating the root cause. Expect follow-up."
Samir Patel: Next steps: 1) run live capture on their top 10 endpoints (5m) 2) evaluate whether to add token-level caching 3) plan AB test of per-route small-burst exemptions for this org.
Talia Nguyen: Setting reminder to revert at +20m unless we extend. Will re-evaluate at +15m.
ops-bot: action:rate_limit_adjust COMPLETED id=rl-5467 status=success applied_by=Talia Nguyen
Talia Nguyen: +5m check: still stable, 5xx at 1.8%. Keeping open.
Samir Patel: If this persists we'll coordinate with infra to pin a small dedicated pool for aura-1234 to protect others.
Kelly Ortiz: Handing oncall to Marc in 30m — tagging him for awareness. Marc, if you take over, confirm you can revert or extend.
Marc D'Souza: Acknowledged. If no regression, plan to revert to 200 qps after 20m and capture artifact, else extend in 15m increments with sign-off.
Talia Nguyen: Closing slack thread when revert happens. Postmortem owner: Samir. Follow-ups: update per-org RL runbook with emergency curl snippet and add a guard that requires an approval ping when qps > 1000.
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll open the postmortem ticket and link to rl-5467.
Talia Nguyen: Revert applied at 1748501899. ops-bot confirm: `revert status:ok`
ops-bot: action:rate_limit_revert COMPLETED id=rl-5467 revert_to=200 applied_by=Marc D'Souza
Marc D'Souza: Final check: metrics back to baseline, no outstanding 5xx. Closing incident. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Talia Nguyen: Filing the incident report now, will include timeline + commands + metrics.
Samir Patel: Adding recommendation: evaluate quota bursts and consider per-org soft-queues to avoid manual hotfixes.
Kelly Ortiz: Closing communication loop with accounts and support. Marking incident SEV3.
Talia Nguyen: thread closed.
